title: Senior QA / Test Engineer – Web & Mobile Applications
description:
Senior QA / Test Engineer – Web & Mobile ApplicationsJob Details

**Experience:**
5+ Years

**Location:**
Gurugram, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Joining:**
Immediate Joiners Preferred

**Mandatory Requirement:**
Hands-on Automation Testing Development experience is mandatory.

**Application Scope:**
Web and Mobile Applications (iOS & Android)

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior QA / Test Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience in testing web and mobile applications. The candidate must have strong hands-on experience in Automation Testing Development and should be capable of independently designing, developing, executing, and maintaining automated test solutions.

The role involves working closely with development, product, and business teams to ensure the quality, reliability, security, and performance of enterprise applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks for web and mobile applications.
* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, sanity, exploratory, and end-to-end testing.
* Test web applications across multiple browsers, operating systems, and devices.
* Perform comprehensive testing of Android and iOS applications.
* Conduct API testing and validate REST services, request/response data, authentication, and error handling.
* Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.
* Perform cross-browser, cross-device, compatibility, usability, and interface testing.
* Validate application data and backend transactions using SQL.
* Collaborate with developers to investigate defects, identify root causes, and validate fixes.
* Participate in requirement analysis, sprint planning, test estimation, and release activities.
* Support UAT, pre-production validation, production verification, and post-release testing.
* Continuously improve automation coverage, QA processes, and testing standards.

Mandatory Skills & Experience

* 5+ years of professional experience in Software Testing / Quality Assurance.
* Hands-on experience in Automation Testing Development is mandatory.
* Strong experience in both web and mobile application testing.
* Strong experience with automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, or Cypress.
* Strong programming knowledge in Java, Python, JavaScript, or similar languages for automation development.
* Proven experience developing and maintaining automated functional, regression, and end-to-end test suites.
* Experience with API testing, database testing, and SQL.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and defect lifecycle.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar test and defect management tools.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Mobile Testing Experience

* Experience testing native, hybrid, or cross-platform mobile applications.
* Experience testing different Android and iOS versions, devices, screen sizes, and resolutions.
* Knowledge of mobile-specific functionality including push notifications, permissions, deep links, app installation and upgrades, offline functionality, and background services.
* Experience testing applications under different network conditions, including Wi-Fi, 4G, 5G, and limited connectivity.

Automation & CI/CD

* Experience developing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of Page Object Model, data-driven, keyword-driven, or hybrid automation frameworks.
* Experience integrating automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines.
* Exposure to Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with Appium and mobile automation is highly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of web and mobile security testing and OWASP principles.
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud environments.
* Experience working on enterprise or regulated-domain applications.
* ISTQB or equivalent testing certification is an advantage.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on QA and Automation professional with strong technical expertise across web and mobile platforms. The candidate should be capable of independently owning testing activities, developing automation solutions, identifying quality risks, and contributing to continuous improvement in QA processes and standards.

title: DE - NCLC - M365 Migration And Modernization Senior - GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**DE NCLC Senior – Technology Consulting**
EY GDS Consulting Digital is looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Consultant with strong capabilities in SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Microsoft 365 migrations and Nintex. The resource will be part of the Enterprise Content Management and Modern Workplace team, delivering solutions to clients across regions.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for professionals with expertise in Microsoft 365 consulting, migration and modernization to join our AI Workforce Consulting team. This is an opportunity to contribute to large transformation programs while supporting the growth of our Microsoft 365 service offerings.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work with client and project teams to understand business requirements, current-state environments and modernization objectives.
* Design and deliver SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 solutions using SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP and PowerShell.
* Plan and execute Microsoft 365 migrations, including SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams workloads, with appropriate assessment, remediation, testing and cutover activities.
* Assess and modernize Nintex workflows and forms, including Nintex for SharePoint and Nintex Automation Cloud.
* Prepare technical designs, migration plans, mapping documents, test scripts, deployment guides and operational handover documentation.
* Troubleshoot migration, workflow, solution and integration issues, escalating risks and dependencies when required.
* Ensure deliverables comply with project standards, security requirements, governance processes and technical design principles.
* Support estimates, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts and technical discussions with stakeholders.
* Develop reusable assets, accelerators and best practices for Microsoft 365 migration and modernization engagements.
* Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

**Skills And Attributes**

* 5-8 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
* Strong hands-on experience with SharePoint Framework (SPFx), TypeScript, React, Fluent UI, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
* Good knowledge of SharePoint Online architecture, information architecture, permissions, content types, site designs and governance concepts.
* Experience in Microsoft 365 migrations covering SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Teams, including discovery, assessment, remediation, migration execution, validation and cutover.
* Hands-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
* Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
* Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target-platform decisions.
* Ability to produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
* Experience with tenant-to-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
* Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
* Self-starter with a strong drive to learn and adopt new technologies
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
* Good presentation and client-facing skills
* Ability to work effectively with globally distributed teams
* Collaborative team player with a positive and constructive approach

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* A minimum of 5 years of relevant Microsoft 365, SharePoint, migration or modernization experience.
* Demonstrable hands-on expertise in SPFx and Microsoft 365 migration delivery.
* Practical experience with Nintex workflows and forms.
* Strong consulting, documentation and stakeholder communication skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience in a professional services or consulting organization.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams and translate complex requirements into manageable deliverables.
* Ability to operate independently with minimum supervision and support junior team members

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**About AiSensy**

AiSensy is a WhatsApp-based Marketing & Engagement platform helping businesses generate leads, automate conversations, engage customers, and grow revenue through WhatsApp.

Our platform brings together WhatsApp marketing, AI agents, chatbots, live chat, and Click-to-WhatsApp advertising to help businesses build meaningful customer conversations at scale.

AiSensy is used by
**250,000+ businesses**
, with
**800+ Crore WhatsApp messages exchanged between businesses and users every year**
. We work with leading brands including Skullcandy, Vivo, Rentomojo, Physicswallah, Cosco, Delhi Transport Corporation, and more.

We are a mission-driven, growth-stage startup backed by
**Marsshot.vc, Bluelotus.vc, and 50+ angel investors**
.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a
**Tech Lead**
to provide technical leadership while remaining deeply involved in building and shipping products.

This is a
**hands-on engineering leadership role**
. You will work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and leadership to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

You will own important technical decisions, contribute to architecture and system design, review code, improve engineering practices, mentor engineers, and ensure that products are built with the right balance of
**speed, reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability**
.

The ideal candidate is someone who can move comfortably between
**architecture-level thinking and hands-on implementation**
. You should be able to simplify complex technical problems, make pragmatic trade-offs, and help the team deliver high-quality software in a fast-moving environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own Technical Design & Architecture:**
  Design scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems for new products and major features. Evaluate architectural trade-offs and make decisions that support both current requirements and future scale.
* **Lead Technical Execution:**
  Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to break complex requirements into clear technical solutions, milestones, and deliverables. Take ownership of critical projects from design through production.
* **Stay Hands-On with Development:**
  Contribute directly to the codebase, particularly on complex, high-impact, or technically challenging problems. The role is not limited to reviews or delegation.
* **Drive Engineering Quality:**
  Establish and maintain high standards for code quality, testing, documentation, observability, performance, and maintainability.
* **Conduct Code Reviews:**
  Review important changes, identify technical risks, promote clean coding practices, and ensure consistency across the codebase.
* **Solve Complex Technical Problems:**
  Investigate and resolve challenging issues related to performance, scalability, reliability, integrations, distributed systems, data, and production environments.
* **Build for Scale & Reliability:**
  Identify potential bottlenecks and design systems capable of handling growing traffic, data, users, integrations, and messaging workloads.
* **Improve Engineering Processes:**
  Identify opportunities to improve development workflows, CI/CD, testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and overall engineering productivity.
* **Mentor & Develop Engineers:**
  Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, help them solve complex problems, conduct technical discussions, and support their growth.
* **Set Technical Standards:**
  Establish best practices around architecture, coding standards, testing, documentation, security, performance, and system reliability.
* **Collaborate Cross-Functionally:**
  Work closely with Product, Design, QA, DevOps, and other teams to ensure technical decisions align with customer and business requirements.
* **Translate Business Requirements into Technical Solutions:**
  Understand the underlying business problem rather than simply implementing feature requests. Help Product teams evaluate technical feasibility, effort, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* **Manage Technical Debt:**
  Identify and prioritize technical debt, refactoring, infrastructure improvements, and architectural risks while balancing them against product delivery priorities.
* **Own Production Reliability:**
  Participate in incident investigation and root-cause analysis. Drive permanent fixes and improvements to prevent recurring production issues.
* **Evaluate New Technologies:**
  Assess tools, frameworks, services, and emerging technologies where they can meaningfully improve product capabilities, engineering efficiency, or scalability.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Experience**

* **5–8+ years of professional software engineering experience**
  , with experience taking technical ownership of significant systems or products.
* Proven experience designing, building, and operating
  **scalable production systems**
  .
* Experience leading technical projects or mentoring engineers in a collaborative engineering environment.
* Strong experience working across the complete software development lifecycle—from technical design and development to testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.
* Experience working in a fast-paced product or startup environment is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* **Strong programming fundamentals:**
  Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented/design principles, and software engineering best practices.
* **System Design:**
  Strong ability to design scalable, fault-tolerant, secure, and maintainable systems.
* **Backend Engineering:**
  Strong experience building APIs, services, integrations, and backend systems.
* **Database Expertise:**
  Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modelling, indexing, transactions, and performance optimization.
* **Distributed Systems:**
  Understanding of asynchronous processing, queues, caching, concurrency, event-driven architectures, and distributed system trade-offs.
* **API & Integrations:**
  Experience designing and integrating REST APIs, webhooks, third-party services, and external platforms.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
  Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, deployment, networking, containers, and CI/CD practices.
* **Testing & Quality:**
  Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, debugging, observability, and production readiness.
* **Security:**
  Understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, data protection, and secure engineering practices.

**Leadership & Ownership**

* Strong ability to make technical decisions and communicate the reasoning behind them.
* Ability to balance
  **speed of execution with long-term technical quality**
  .
* Strong mentoring and coaching skills with the ability to raise the technical bar across the team.
* Ability to break ambiguous problems into clear technical approaches.
* Strong communication skills across both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* High ownership, accountability, and bias toward solving problems rather than simply identifying them.

**Good to Have**

* Experience building
  **high-scale SaaS or B2B products**
  .
* Experience with
  **messaging platforms, communication APIs, automation, AI, chatbots, or customer engagement products**
  .
* Experience handling high-volume event processing, messaging, or real-time systems.
* Experience with
  **WhatsApp Business API or similar communication platforms**
  .
* Experience with AI/LLM-based applications, agents, or AI-assisted product experiences.
* Experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, Kafka/RabbitMQ, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or similar technologies.
* Experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, or modern cloud infrastructure.
* Experience owning production systems and participating in on-call, incident management, and post-incident reviews.
* Experience hiring, interviewing, and developing software engineers.

**What Success Looks Like**

In this role, success means:

* Engineering teams can move quickly without compromising fundamental technical quality.
* Systems remain reliable and scalable as AiSensy grows.
* Technical decisions are clearly reasoned and aligned with product and business priorities.
* Engineers receive strong technical guidance and become increasingly independent.
* Critical technical problems are solved proactively rather than repeatedly becoming production issues.
* Architecture and engineering practices evolve as the product and scale evolve.
* Product, engineering, and business teams have strong alignment on technical trade-offs and delivery expectations.

**Why Join AiSensy?**

* Build technology powering
  **WhatsApp engagement for 250,000+ businesses**
  .
* Solve interesting engineering challenges around scale, messaging, automation, integrations, and AI.
* Take meaningful ownership of architecture and technical direction.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and leadership.
* Build systems used by leading businesses across industries.
* Work in a high-ownership, fast-paced product environment.
* Help shape the engineering practices and technology foundation as AiSensy scales.

**Apply Now**
and be part of the AiSensy growth story.

title: Finance Manager, Mobile Business Development (Fuse)
description:
**Description**
Are you ready to shape the future of Amazon's digital services distribution through strategic financial leadership? Amazon Fuse & Mobile Business Development (MBD) Finance Team is seeking an innovative finance professional with exceptional analytical skills and business judgment to accelerate Amazon's growth through partnerships with Mobile Operators, video distributors, and Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) worldwide. This high-impact role focuses on supporting some of Amazon's most strategic commercial partnerships in India and Asia Pacific, where you'll build complex financial models, quantify customer value, and influence senior leadership decisions.
  
  
As a key finance partner, you'll work at the intersection of finance, business development, and marketing, transforming complex datasets into actionable insights that drive Amazon's flywheel. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop rigorous analysis, challenge business assumptions, and deliver recommendations that shape multi-million dollar partnerships. This is a unique opportunity to join a centralized corporate business development team where your financial expertise will directly impact how millions of customers access Amazon's digital services globally.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build complex, scalable, and flexible financial models to evaluate partnership opportunities, interpret data, and deliver recommendations that drive results and influence leaders throughout Amazon
* Develop and report key input metrics that support business growth, transforming complex datasets into actionable insights for decision-making on strategic partnerships
* Partner with business development and marketing teams to challenge business assumptions, evaluate partnership economics, and provide thought leadership in quantifying the value of distinct customer behaviors
* Collaborate with finance leaders and Business Intelligence teams to enhance and automate financial reports for business reviews, ensuring accuracy in billing, cost allocation, and financial presentations
* Communicate financial strategies and analysis to VP level leaders, effectively influencing stakeholders across a matrixed environment while navigating ambiguity in uncharted territory

A day in the life
  
  
You'll start your day analyzing the financial performance of strategic partnerships across India and Asia Pacific, diving deep into partner economics and customer metrics. You'll build sophisticated financial models to evaluate new partnership opportunities with mobile operators or video distributors, then jump into collaborative sessions with business development teams to challenge assumptions and refine deal structures. Throughout the day, you'll work with Business Intelligence teams to automate reporting dashboards, conduct industry research on potential partners, and prepare compelling financial narratives for senior leadership reviews. You'll balance rigorous financial analysis with creative problem-solving, constantly seeking opportunities to advance Amazon's growth initiatives.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Amazon Fuse & Mobile Business Development (MBD) Finance Team is a small, tight-knit group of analytical and creative professionals working on strategic partnerships that accelerate Amazon's flywheel by distributing digital services globally. This centralized corporate business development team partners with Mobile Operators, Multi-channel Video Programming Distributors (MVPDs), and OEMs worldwide to bring Amazon's digital services to millions of customers.
  
  
The team values first-principles thinkers who thrive in fast-paced, constantly evolving environments. You'll work alongside finance professionals who combine rigorous analytical skills with business creativity, diving deep into complex problems while remaining adaptable and action-oriented. The team's mission is to provide thoughtful financial leadership that directly influences senior leaders' decision-making on some of Amazon's most impactful commercial partnerships, with a particular focus on high-growth markets in India and Asia Pacific.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience
* 5+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
* 5+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics or business, or Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance) experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
* MBA, or CPA
* Knowledge of SQL/ETL
* Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
* Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Android Engineer
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for an
**Android Engineer**
to build and scale the Atlys Android app, helping millions of travellers apply for visas faster and with less uncertainty, right from their phones.
  
  
This role is for someone with a strong foundation in native Android development who obsesses over performance, polish and reliability, and who enjoys owning features end to end.
  
  
**The Job**

* Build and ship core app experiences in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose across the visa journey, from discovery and document upload to payments and application tracking.
* Own app quality and performance, keeping startup time, crash and ANR rates, app size and battery usage in check across a wide range of devices and network conditions.
* Bring AI into the app by turning AI-powered flows such as smart document capture, conversational assistance into fast, native experiences.
* Ship fast with product, design and backend, running experiments and iterating on features based on data.
* Raise the engineering bar through clean architecture, thoughtful code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have 3-5 years of Android development experience, including shipping and scaling at least one consumer app on the Play Store.
* Are exceptionally strong in Kotlin, including coroutines and Flow, with hands-on experience in Jetpack Compose and Android Jetpack libraries.
* Have a solid grasp of modern app architecture (MVVM/MVI, Clean Architecture), dependency injection (Hilt or Dagger) and modularisation.
* Have built robust networking and data layers using REST/GraphQL APIs, Retrofit/OkHttp, Room and offline-first patterns.
* Know how to measure and improve app health using tools such as Firebase Crashlytics, Android Profiler and analytics or experimentation SDKs.
* Have exposure to CameraX, ML Kit or on-device ML, payment integrations, Kotlin Multiplatform, or building in fintech, travel or other high-compliance domains (a strong plus).

**Here's What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Company Description**

Nikah Forever is India’s leading community matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages convenient and meaningful for the Muslim community. With
**over 5 Million+ members**

, we are redefining how people connect and build lifelong relationships through trust, technology, and cultural understanding.

Our mission is to simplify the marriage journey while fostering genuine connections rooted in shared values and traditions.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a
**SDET with strong coding fundamentals, practical AI skills, and a creative problem-solving mindset**
. You should enjoy exploring how systems work, finding unexpected ways they can fail, and writing code to test them. Your work will go beyond the UI—covering
**mobile, web, APIs, backend services, databases, and third-party integrations**
.

We value a mindsets like : question assumptions, investigate unusual behaviour, think beyond predefined test cases, and turn repetitive work into automation. Freshers with strong projects, internships, or demonstrated practical skills are welcome. You’ll work closely with engineering and product teams, taking increasing ownership as you learn the platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Test Automation & Engineering**

* Build and maintain automated tests for critical web, mobile, and API workflows.
* Write reusable test utilities, assertions, and scripts using
  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java**
  .
* Use frameworks such as
  **Playwright, Appium, Selenium, or equivalent tools**
  , depending on the application.
* Create reliable test data and investigate failing or flaky tests.
* Contribute to running automated tests through CI/CD pipelines.

**Functional & Exploratory Testing**

* Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, boundary, negative, and end-to-end testing.
* Validate journeys across onboarding, profiles, search, chat, notifications, subscriptions, and payments.
* Think beyond the happy path: test interrupted journeys, repeated actions, unexpected inputs, and changing network conditions.
* Verify features against requirements and help identify missing acceptance criteria.

**API, Backend & Database Validation**

* Test APIs using
  **Postman and code-based automated tests**
  .
* Validate payloads, status codes, authentication, business rules, and error handling.
* Use
  **SQL**
  to verify records, state transitions, and consistency across UI, API, and database.
* Read application/server logs and trace issues across
  **UI → API → backend → database**
  .
* Validate integrations with payment gateways, OTP/SMS/WhatsApp services, and notifications.

**Mobile & Payment Flows**

* Test Android and iOS apps, including applications built with
  **Flutter**
  .
* Validate permissions, deep links, push notifications, app lifecycle, and network-related behaviour.
* Test checkout, subscriptions, trials, offers, and payment success, failure, cancellation, retry, and timeout scenarios.
* Check that transaction states remain consistent across the application and backend.

**AI-Assisted Testing & Problem Solving**

* Use AI coding assistants and LLMs to support test design, automation, debugging, and defect investigation.
* Provide relevant requirements, code, logs, and API details to get useful AI output.
* Review and validate generated code and test cases for correctness, coverage, and maintainability.
* Build small scripts or tools that improve testing speed and reduce repetitive effort.
* Exercise judgment when sharing application data with AI tools.

**Defect Investigation & Release Quality**

* Write clear bug reports with reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, and supporting evidence.
* Work with developers to isolate issues and contribute to root cause analysis.
* Verify fixes, run regression checks, and support release smoke testing and post-release validation.

**Required Skills**

* **0–1 year of experience**
  in testing, development, or automation; relevant projects and internships count.
* Ability to write and debug code in
  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java**
  .
* Practical exposure to at least one test automation framework.
* Understanding of testing fundamentals, SDLC, and the defect life cycle.
* Working knowledge of
  **HTTP, REST APIs, Postman, and SQL**
  .
* Ability to use logs and other evidence to investigate issues systematically.
* Practical experience using
  **AI tools for engineering tasks**
  , with the ability to explain and verify their output.
* Clear written communication and structured bug reporting.
* Curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn.

**Nice to Have**

* Projects involving mobile automation, Flutter testing, or API test suites.
* Familiarity with
  **Git, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or other CI/CD tools**
  .
* Exposure to payment gateways, webhooks, or third-party integrations.
* Basic understanding of performance testing, concurrency, and security testing.
* Personal tools, GitHub contributions, or examples of bugs you discovered independently.

**Who Will Thrive Here?**

Someone who asks
**“What else could go wrong?”**
, follows evidence to understand the cause, and builds a repeatable way to catch the issue next time.

You don’t need to know every tool on day one. We’re looking for
**strong fundamentals, practical AI fluency, independent thinking, and the drive to build**
.

**Founder's Desk - Why does this role Matters**

“Quality builds trust. Every successful connection on Nikah Forever depends on the reliability of our platform. As a QA Engineer Intern, your attention to detail ensures that every user’s experience is smooth, meaningful, and free of friction.” — CEO, Nikah Forever

**How to Apply**

Share your resume along with a project, automation script, GitHub repository, or an interesting bug you discovered. Tell us
**how you approached the problem, what you learned, and how you used AI, if applicable.**

description:

We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

This position works as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale browser based or mobile applications developed with current Microsoft development languages and technologies, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

A senior engineer is a senior role in Software Agile delivery team. The person is responsible for managing and executing the complex software modules almost independently. Additionally, the indvidual is responsible of guding and mentoring junior engineers in the team from technology standpoint.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during cucial conversations.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions,

title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech, UTR Tech
description:
**Description**
Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
  
  
UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises - Same-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1-hr/3-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time-critical orders on-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with very large distributed systems
* Knowledge of design process
* Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Applied AI Sr Associate Engineer
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
Skills and Competencies
  
  

* 3–5 years of hands-on full-stack engineering experience with a track record of independently delivering production-quality applications end to end; proficiency in React 18 with TypeScript (component architecture, hooks, state management with Zustand or Redux, and React Router for complex multi-view portals), Node.js/Express for BFF APIs (including authentication flows, request proxying, caching, and structured error handling), and Python/FastAPI for backend microservices and data processing pipelines.
* Solid understanding of SQL, PostgreSQL (schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and workflow state persistence) and Redis (caching, session management, and task queue brokering via Celery or equivalent); proficiency with Docker for containerizing Node.js and Python services with identical dev/prod environments; ability to build and maintain GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines covering lint, unit test, build, and zero-downtime deploy on merge.
* Experience integrating with Salesforce REST APIs and SOQL — reading Cases, Accounts, Contacts, Tasks, and Activity History at volume — is preferred; familiarity with Salesforce Connected App setup, OAuth 2.0 flows, and per-user token management; experience triggering write-backs via Flows or Apex REST endpoints with validation gates and audit logging; exposure to Salesforce Platform Events or Pub/Sub API for real-time case state change handling is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience integrating LLM models into production applications — prompt engineering, context management, structured output parsing, and cost control; familiarity with LangChain (Python) or equivalent orchestration frameworks for chaining LLM calls, managing memory, and enforcing guardrails; understanding of embedding-based semantic search (text-embedding-ada-002 or similar) for similarity scoring and duplicate detection; commitment to human-in-the-loop design — AI assists and drafts; humans review and commit — enforced at the API layer, not just the UI.
* Proficiency with Pandas and openpyxl for Excel-in/Excel-out data processing pipelines; experience with fuzzy matching libraries (RapidFuzz or similar) for entity deduplication and overlap analysis; exposure to graph traversal (NetworkX or equivalent) for ownership hierarchy and relation analysis; ability to integrate with external data APIs.
* Strong grasp of REST API design principles including versioning, error contracts, pagination, and backward compatibility; ability to write well-structured, tested code — unit tests, integration tests, and API contract tests as part of the development workflow, not an afterthought; experience maintaining an append-only audit log tied to business entity IDs for compliance and traceability; comfortable self-managing across frontend, backend, AI, and infrastructure layers in a high-autonomy environment within a 2-week sprint cadence.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Responsibilities**

* Build an end-to-end AI-assisted operations platform that replaces manual Salesforce workflows and spreadsheet-based processes with an auditable, intelligent console. Implement the full AI-driven platform architecture across multiple production phases; build the React 18 + TypeScript portal spanning all stakeholder views; engineer the FastAPI Python workflow service with async Excel-in/Excel-out processing, Celery task queuing, and status polling.
* Provision and maintain the Salesforce Connected App; manage the OAuth token lifecycle; implement read operations across Cases, Accounts, Contacts, Tasks, and Activity History; build validated Salesforce write-back flows (merge, email update, segment patch) with AI pre-flight checks and analyst confirmation gates before any SFDC commit; implement real-time case state monitoring via Salesforce Platform Events to drive escalation detection.
* Integrate case summarization, duplicate analysis, action pre-flight checks, and an AI chat assistant pre-seeded with live case context; implement the escalation prediction engine; enforce human-in-the-loop guardrails at the API layer.
* Manage phased delivery with defined go-live milestones; lead UAT sessions with analysts, managers, and leadership at each phase go-live, and incorporate feedback into the subsequent sprint backlog; maintain Azure infrastructure, monitor application health, and own incident response throughout the build period.
* Document architecture decisions, API contracts, data schemas, and operational runbooks to support long-term maintainability beyond the build phase.

**About The Team**
Our Data Management & Analytics team within COR OU is responsible for maintaining Account and Contact information with CRM, we are currently looking at transformation towards AI-assisted operations platform that converts manual Salesforce workflows, spreadsheet-based verification, and ad-hoc bulk data processes into a structured, auditable, and intelligent console.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. title: Mobile Platform Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
**Mobile Platform Engineer**
 Join EY as a Mobile Platform Engineer and be at the forefront of designing and implementing innovative mobile solutions that enhance our services and drive efficiency. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of our mobile environment, working autonomously while collaborating closely with key stakeholders across the globe.

By designing, testing, and implementing new mobile products and services within our Intune\-based mobile environment, you will contribute to creating and maintaining a seamless experiences for our Mobile users. title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
description:
**Description**
 Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume \+ complex business rules in a highly distributed and service\-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper\-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
   

  

 This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid\-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade\-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short\-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over\-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
   

  

**A Day In The Life**
 You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand\-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on\-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.
* Responsible for CI/CD pipelines and suggest ways to improve the code delivery process.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3\+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Software Development Engineer - II
description:
**About GoKwik**
 GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, powering merchants across checkout optimisation, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post\-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables 15,000\+ merchants globally, processes \~$2 billion in GMV, and is rapidly scaling across India, the UK, Europe, and the US. Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments, GoKwik has raised $68 million in funding, including a $13 million growth round in June 2025, and is building AI\-powered infrastructure to shape the future of eCommerce.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 As a Software Development Engineer \- II, you'll build and scale the backend systems that power GoKwik's checkout, payments, and post\-purchase products. You'll own services end\-to\-end, make architectural decisions that improve platform reliability and performance, and mentor engineers while driving complex technical initiatives. The systems you build directly influence merchant conversions, customer experience, and platform scalability.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and NestJS, with Go for selected services.
* Build and optimize distributed systems using PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Kafka.

title: Technical Operations & QA Executive – Web & Mobile Platforms
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 



  





 Technical Operations \& QA Executive – Web \& Mobile Platforms
 



  





 Company: RHOPE – Royal House of Psychiatry
 



 Location: Remote / Hybrid
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Salary: ₹25,000–₹30,000/month
 



 Experience: 1–3 years preferred
 



  





 ABOUT RHOPE
 



  





 RHOPE – Royal House of Psychiatry is a mental healthcare organisation providing online and offline mental health services through clinics, digital platforms and technology\-enabled patient systems.
 



  





 Our technology ecosystem includes our website, online consultation platform, mobile applications, appointment/payment systems, CRM, communication tools, analytics, dashboards and third\-party integrations.
 



  





 We are looking for a technically capable Technical Operations \& QA Executive to oversee RHOPE’s technology ecosystem internally.
 



  





 ROLE OVERVIEW
 



  





 This is not purely a software development role. The primary responsibility is to monitor, test and improve RHOPE’s technology and identify problems before they affect patients, revenue or management.
 



  





 You must be able to:
 



  





 \* Identify and investigate problems
 



 \* Document issues clearly
 



 \* Coordinate with developers/vendors
 



 \* Follow up until resolution
 



 \* Test fixes independently
 



 \* Escalate critical issues
 



 \* Ensure RHOPE retains ownership/access to its technology, accounts and source code
 



  





 The ideal candidate finds problems before management does.
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. Technology Monitoring \& Patient Journey Testing
 



  





 Monitor:
 



  





 \* Website/mobile website
 



 \* Online consultation platform
 



 \* Android/iOS applications
 



 \* Booking, payment and login/OTP systems
 



 \* Doctor, patient and admin dashboards
 



 \* WhatsApp, CRM and API integrations
 



 \* Video consultation systems
 



 \* Email/SMS notifications
 



  





 Test the complete journey:
 



  





 Ad/Search → Website → Service Selection → Booking → Payment → Confirmation → Consultation → Follow\-up
 



  





 Verify forms, links, OTPs, payments, appointments, notifications, consultation links, WhatsApp handoffs and patient\-data flows across desktop and mobile.
 



  





 2\. Bug Detection \& Issue Resolution
 



  





 Identify bugs, broken links/forms, payment/login failures, OTP issues, API failures, server errors, slow pages, mobile issues, analytics errors, notification failures, dashboard problems and UX issues.
 



  





 Maintain an issue tracker:
 



  





 Issue → Priority → Impact → Owner/Vendor → Date → Deadline → Status → Resolution
 



  





 Follow up until resolution. Never close an issue simply because a developer says it is fixed; test and confirm the fix independently.
 



  





 3\. Developer \& Vendor Coordination
 



  





 Work with developers, agencies and vendors to communicate issues, track work/deadlines, verify implementations, question unclear explanations, escalate delays and maintain records/handover documentation.
 



  





 You must be technically capable of meaningful conversations with developers.
 



  





 4\. Technology Ownership, Access \& Source Code
 



  





 Maintain records of RHOPE’s technology accounts, including where applicable:
 



  





 \* GitHub/GitLab
 



 \* Hosting, domain and DNS
 



 \* AWS/cloud, databases and Firebase
 



 \* Google Play Console / Apple Developer
 



 \* Razorpay/payment gateways
 



 \* Google Analytics, Tag Manager and Search Console
 



 \* Microsoft Clarity and Meta Business Manager/Pixel
 



 \* WhatsApp API, CRM and email/SMS/OTP providers
 



 \* APIs and third\-party software
 



  





 RHOPE must not depend on external developers’ personal accounts for critical technology.
 



  





 Ensure access is documented and updated when employees/vendors join or leave. Ensure repository access, regular code commits, backups and proper handover.
 



  





 Git/GitHub fundamentals are expected.
 



  





 5\. Analytics, Cloud \& Integrations
 



  





 Verify GA4, GTM, Search Console, Clarity, Meta Pixel, Google/Meta Ads tracking and Looker Studio. Confirm leads, forms, bookings, payments and consultation requests are tracked correctly.
 



  





 Basic AWS/cloud knowledge is expected. You should understand basic hosting, service/server status, logs, backups and unusual cloud costs.
 



  





 Monitor payment gateways, WhatsApp, CRM, SMS/OTP, email, video consultation, Google/Meta services and other APIs. Help determine whether failures originate from RHOPE, configuration, implementation, an API or third\-party provider.
 



  





 6\. Release \& QA Testing
 



  





 Before major website/app changes go live, test:
 



  





 \* Desktop/mobile website
 



 \* Android/iOS applications
 



 \* Login/OTP
 



 \* Booking and payments
 



 \* Forms and links
 



 \* Notifications/dashboards
 



 \* Major integrations
 



 \* Analytics events
 



  





 A release is not complete simply because a developer says it is complete.
 



  





 7\. Security \& Technology Hygiene
 



  





 Help maintain appropriate permissions, remove former employee/vendor access, use strong authentication, securely handle credentials/API keys, maintain SSL/HTTPS and backups, and identify/escalate suspicious activity or vulnerabilities.
 



  





 Specialised cybersecurity may be handled externally. Because RHOPE operates in healthcare, careful handling of patient and company data is essential.
 



  





 DOCUMENTATION \& REPORTING
 



  





 Maintain documentation covering technology systems, developers/vendors, account ownership/access, integrations/APIs, repositories, hosting/cloud infrastructure, issues, subscriptions, backups and renewals.
 



  





 Submit a weekly technology health report:
 



  





 🔴 CRITICAL — Patient, payment, security, data, availability, booking or major operational impact.
 



  





 🟠 NEEDS ATTENTION — Important but not currently critical.
 



  





 🟢 WORKING NORMALLY — Important systems checked and functioning correctly.
 



  





 For open issues:
 



  





 Issue \| Impact \| Responsible Person \| Deadline \| Status
 



  





 Management should understand RHOPE’s technology status without individually chasing developers.
 



  





 REQUIRED TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE
 



  





 Web: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React or similar, responsive design
 



  





 Backend/APIs: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, backend systems, Node.js or similar
 



  





 Databases: SQL/MySQL fundamentals, queries and backups
 



  





 Development: Git, GitHub/GitLab, development environments and basic deployment
 



  





 Cloud: AWS or similar, servers, databases, storage, logs and backups
 



  





 QA: Website/app testing, bug reproduction, documentation, regression testing and cross\-device/browser testing
 



  





 ADVANTAGEOUS EXPERIENCE
 



  





 GA4, GTM, Clarity, Search Console, Meta Pixel, Razorpay, WhatsApp Business APIs, CRM, Firebase, AWS, React, React Native, Node.js, MySQL, SaaS or HealthTech products.
 



  





 EXPERIENCE
 



  





 Preferred: 1–3 years
 



  





 Relevant backgrounds include QA Engineer, Technical Operations, Technical Support Engineer, Junior Full\-Stack Developer, Implementation Engineer, SaaS Operations, Product/Technology Operations or Technical Project Coordinator.
 



  





 Exceptional freshers with strong practical technical ability may also be considered.
 



  





 WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO
 



  





 \* Finds problems without being asked
 



 \* Takes ownership and follows up
 



 \* Is curious about how systems work
 



 \* Is comfortable questioning developers
 



 \* Does not accept “it’s fixed” without testing
 



 \* Is organised and documents properly
 



 \* Notices inconsistencies and investigates independently
 



 \* Communicates effectively with technical and non\-technical teams
 



 \* Understands issues affecting patients or revenue
 



 \* Can work independently and reliably
 



  





 THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



  





 You do not need to be a senior software architect, cybersecurity specialist, AWS architect, Kubernetes specialist or expert programmer in every language.
 



  





 Complex development and specialised technical work can remain with developers and external specialists.
 



  





 Your responsibility is to understand what is happening, identify problems, coordinate the right people, follow through and verify that the problem is solved.
 



  





 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
 



  





 1\. Proactive Issue Detection — Finding problems before they affect patients or management.
 



 2\. Resolution Follow\-Up — Ensuring issues reach confirmed resolution.
 



 3\. Platform Reliability — Monitoring critical patient\-facing systems.
 



 4\. Quality Assurance — Testing releases and fixes.
 



 5\. Documentation — Accurate technology, access and vendor records.
 



 6\. Account \& Access Control — Ensuring RHOPE retains control of its technology.
 



 7\. Reporting — Clear reporting of risks and pending issues.
 



 8\. Responsiveness — Timely identification, escalation and coordination.
 



  





 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 



  





 Management should not have to discover technical problems accidentally.
 



  





 The Technical Operations \& QA Executive should be able to tell management:
 



  





 \* What is working
 



 \* What is not working
 



 \* What needs attention
 



 \* Who is responsible
 



 \* When it should be fixed
 



 \* Whether the fix has been tested
 



 \* Whether RHOPE has proper access and control
 



  





 That is the core purpose of this position.
 



  





 COMPENSATION \& WORKING MODEL
 



  





 ₹25,000–₹30,000/month, depending on experience and practical technical ability.
 



  





 The role may be remote, provided the candidate is disciplined, responsive and available during agreed working hours.
 



  





 SELECTION PROCESS
 



  





 Shortlisted candidates may receive a practical assessment involving:
 



  





 \* Reviewing a website/platform
 



 \* Identifying technical and UX issues
 



 \* Documenting findings
 



 \* Prioritising issues by impact
 



 \* Explaining investigation and resolution steps
 



  





 Practical problem\-solving ability will carry significant weight in selection.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Experience around 7 to 11 years, in Adobe Target implementation and experimentation along with Launch, Tagging, Analytics \& Adobe Experience platform – WebSDK.
* WebSDK exposure is mandatory.
* Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, CSS3
* Strong experience in debugging client\-side implementations, working with Browser developer tools, debugging frameworks and network requests.
* Expert level in implementing and troubleshooting A/B testing and personalization solutions with strong understanding of Single Page Applications (SPA) data layers, XDM schemas, event\-driven tracking architectures.
* Experience with enterprise digital analytics and customer experience optimization programs.
* Exposure to Agile/Scrum, product development methodologies with a strong trait of collaboration
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.


**Preferred Educational Qualifications**
* B.E. / B. Tech
* Certification in Adobe Stack / Adobe Target Preferred
* Masters/ MBA / MCA would be an added advantage.


**Adobe Target \& Experimentation**
* Design, develop, and implement A/B tests, Multivariate Tests (MVT), Experience Targeting (XT), and Personalization activities using Adobe Target.
* Evaluate experimentation requirements and determine the technical feasibility of implementation.
* Develop custom Adobe Target activities using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Implement and validate audience targeting strategies and personalization experiences.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, analysts, and developers to translate experimentation requirements into scalable solutions.
* Ensure experimentation activities adhere to performance, accessibility, and governance standards.


**Technical Development**
* Develop and modify front\-end experiences using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Create custom scripts and solutions to support complex experimentation scenarios.
* Troubleshoot and resolve implementation issues related to Adobe Target activities.
* Validate experiment execution across browsers, devices, and environments.
* Work closely with development teams to implement server\-side and client\-side experimentation solutions.


**Debugging \& Troubleshooting**
* Perform deep\-dive debugging of Adobe Target implementations and experiment delivery issues.
* Analyze activity qualification, audience membership, mbox requests, profile scripts, and offer rendering issues.
* Investigate tracking discrepancies and identify root causes affecting experiment performance.
* Support production troubleshooting and incident resolution related to experimentation deployments.
* Utilize browser developer tools, Adobe Experience Platform Debugger, and network analysis tools for issue investigation.


**Analytics \& Tagging Collaboration**
* Partner with analytics teams to ensure experiments are measured correctly.
* Validate experiment data collection and reporting accuracy.
* Support integration between Adobe Target and Adobe Analytics.
* Collaborate on Web SDK and Adobe Launch implementations to enable experimentation and measurement.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Lead, Tech (HC Dev)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for exceptional programmers to join our Human Capital Development (HC Dev) team based out of Gurugram, Hyderabad or Bengaluru, which is rebuilding its core infrastructure and applications to enhance efficiency, enable data\-driven decision\-making, and deliver next\-generation analytics capabilities. The role offers an opportunity to provide technical and delivery leadership through active involvement in system design, architecture, and implementation, leading initiatives that evolve our platforms, improve maintainability, and deliver secure, scalable, and high\-performing systems. You will align technology direction with business goals, guide teams toward architectural excellence, and strengthen the reliability, resilience, and performance of critical systems.

You will work on a range of back\-end and front\-end technologies including Java, Spring, TypeScript, React, and SQL Server, while participating actively in design and code reviews. You will remain hands\-on in design and development while guiding the team in engineering best practices. You will also troubleshoot business\-critical issues, solve complex technical challenges, and mentor junior team members on both technology and domain aspects to support their growth and development.
   

  

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
 The ideal candidate should hold\-
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field with 6 to 9 years of work experience
* Strong full\-stack development experience with Java and Spring or similar frameworks on the back end, and TypeScript and React on the front end, with familiarity in SQL.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with a demonstrated passion for technology, quality, and attention to detail.
* Proven experience in end\-to\-end project delivery, including planning, execution, and stakeholder communication; people management experience is a plus.
* Excellent reasoning ability, interpersonal, and communication skills, as the role involves frequent interaction with business groups.


 Advanced Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience integrating GenAI workflows, including RAG pipelines, using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or equivalent tools to build scalable AI applications is a plus.


 Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/LeadHCDevSept26
   

  

 We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender\-neutral return\-to\-work initiative.
   

  

 The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers
   

  

 Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

title: Agentic AI Intern
description:
**Company Description** 




 Primebook, a product of Floydwiz Technologies Pvt. Ltd., is India's first Android\-based laptop designed to empower students, self\-learners, creators, coders, and professionals. Founded in 2018 by IIT Delhi alumni, Primebook is on a mission to make computing accessible to India's youth. At the core of Primebook is PrimeOS, a custom Android\-based operating system that combines the simplicity of Android with the power of a PC. It offers full\-screen apps, multitasking, a desktop\-grade browser, and access to the Prime App Store. PrimeOS also includes PrimeAGNT, an operator AI that uses the laptop the way a person does, reading the screen and working through real apps and websites to finish tasks for the user.
 



  





**Internship Details** 




**Role** 
 : Agentic AI Intern
 



**Location** 
 : On\-site, New Delhi
 



**Type** 
 : Full\-time Paid Internship
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for Agentic AI Interns to join the team building PrimeAGNT. This is a hands\-on role where you will work on the agent itself. You will test it on real tasks, find where it breaks, and help fix it. Students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Android or browser automation experience is a plus but not mandatory. We will mentor you on the platform side if your fundamentals are solid.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Run PrimeAGNT on real tasks across apps and websites, and document where and why it fails
* Build and maintain test cases and evaluation suites that catch bugs before users do
* Reproduce failures from device logs and agent traces, and write clear bug reports
* Test critical flows such as confirmations before sending messages or making payments
* Compare AI models and prompt changes on success rate, cost, and speed
* Test with real users who use Hindi and English, and turn their issues into test cases
* Ship fixes where you can, including prompt changes, guardrails, and better handling of slow or unpredictable screens



  





**Must Have** 



* Hands\-on experience with any LLM API such as OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude. Tool calling, JSON outputs, or a simple agent project all count.
* Solid fundamentals in Kotlin or Java
* Comfort with a terminal, git, and reading logs
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Clear written communication, since most of your work will be bug reports and test cases
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a B.E., B.Tech, MCA, or equivalent degree



  





**Good to Have** 



* Android development experience, especially Accessibility services or adb
* Browser automation with Puppeteer, Playwright, or Chrome DevTools Protocol
* Ability to read and write Hindi
* An active GitHub profile with AI or automation projects

title: Mobile Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Mobile Automation Engineer
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana (Onsite)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time

 3–5 years
 



  





**About Visitly** 




 Visitly is a leading Visitor Management provider, dedicated to delivering innovative solutions to keep our customers efficient and secure. Our team thrives on collaboration, creativity, and a commitment to excellence.

 We are seeking a hands\-on Mobile Automation Engineer to join our team as an Individual Contributor. This role is entirely focused on building a QA automation framework. Your primary mandate will be to set up and build robust, scalable automated testing frameworks across our entire product suite: React \& Angular web platforms, mobile applications, React Native kiosk systems, and backend REST APIs. You will also actively leverage AI—specifically Claude—to accelerate framework development and translate product functional requirements into comprehensive automated tests.

* Construct automated testing solutions for complex frontend applications built on React and Angular, ensuring cross\-browser compatibility and UI reliability

-

* Strong programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript
* Deep experience with web automation tools (Cypress, Playwright, or WebdriverIO) for modern SPAs

* Direct experience building testing frameworks for React Native; prior experience testing hardware software, POS systems, or kiosk applications highly desirable

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud device farms (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, AWS Device Farm)
