 About Infrasity
 



 Infrasity is an engineering\-led GTM company. We partner with DevTools, infrastructure, and AI startups to help them launch fast, showcase product features, and reach their developer audience. Our work spans technical content, community\-driven distribution, and developer\-focused marketing all with the depth and credibility of engineers.
 



  





  





**Role Overview** 
 You'll build small, sharp, public things: agents, MCP servers, Claude skills, and open\-source repos. Some serve Infrasity's own GTM stack (e.g. our MCP server at app.infrasity.com/api/mcp, our dev\-gtm\-claude\-skills repo); some turn a client's product into a working demo developers can clone and run. Writing matters — clean READMEs, a tight launch post — but it's how you ship what you built, not the deliverable itself. If your instinct when you learn a new tool is "let me wire up an agent / skill / repo around it," this is your role.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Build and ship MCP servers, Claude skills, agents, and CLIs — real, runnable, public.
* Stand up open\-source repos end to end: working code, clean README, examples, and a launch (GitHub, Reddit, Dev.to, HN where it fits).
* Turn client product features into developer\-first artifacts: sample apps, SDK integrations, automation workflows.
* Write the docs the build needs — READMEs, quickstarts, walkthroughs — grounded in code you actually wrote.
* Instrument and watch traction: stars, clones, backlinks, signups. Tie what you ship to outcomes.
* Engage in the communities where your work lands — answer questions, take feedback, iterate.



**What Success Looks Like** 



* A steady stream of public, working artifacts (repos / skills / MCP servers / agents) that developers star, clone, and use.
* Launches that drive real backlinks and traffic to Infrasity and client sites.
* Developers treat Infrasity's output as credible because the code holds up — not because the post reads well.



**You Should Apply If** 



* You've shipped something public: an OSS repo, an MCP server, a Claude skill, an agent, a working SDK demo.
 **Share links — code first.**
* You're comfortable reading a product's docs/API and building against it without hand\-holding.
* You can write a clear README and a launch post once the thing works.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customer engineering teams to ship production\-grade Cursor workflows that measurably improve how they build software.
   

  

 You’ll figure out what’s actually slowing a team down, design a practical solution, and own it end\-to\-end, from first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post\-production support. This is not a demo role. You are responsible for systems that work in the real world. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, New Delhi and Mumbai.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Lead discovery with customer engineers to identify the real bottleneck and define clear success metrics
* Design and build Cursor\-powered workflows (e.g., large\-scale refactors, migrations, PR review loops, incident → fix pipelines, spec → implementation systems)
* Ship a fast first version in days, then harden it into something reliable over weeks with proper rollout plans, monitoring, and iteration based on real usage
* Own production quality: tracing, evals, metrics, debugging model behavior, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure modes
* Work directly with Staff\+/Platform/Eng leaders — going deep in code while also communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and push improvements back into the core Cursor product


 You may be a fit if
   

  

* You thrive in ambiguity and can turn fuzzy problems into clear scopes and shipped systems
* You’ve built and owned AI\-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real\-world model failures
* You’re comfortable leading discovery conversations and being accountable for customer outcomes
* You build end\-to\-end \- if it needs frontend, backend, infra, or prompt iteration, you’ll own it
* You’ve handled production reliability before (metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response)
* You’re strong in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript and can ramp quickly on new stacks

* Experience in at least one of the OSS COTS products (E.g. Netcracker, Ericsson, Nokia, etc.)

title: Technology Specialist
description:
**About Us**
 Join us at Orange Business!
   

  

 We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
   

  

 Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Primary focus: Genesys Cloud contact\-centre automation, IVR and Architect development, routing, integrations, analytics, and CI/CD enablement.
   

  

 Role Purpose The Genesys Cloud Automation \& DevOps Engineer will support the customer global Genesys Cloud contact centre environment by developing automated solutions, integrations, call flows, routing configurations, and deployment pipelines. The resource will focus on improving operational resilience, reducing manual configuration effort, enabling faster delivery, and enhancing customer and agent experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Genesys Cloud Development And Configuration**
* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain Genesys Cloud solutions across IVR and non\-IVR markets.
* Develop and enhance Genesys Cloud Architect call flows, including inbound, outbound, IVR, bot, and routing flows.
* Configure and automate:
* queues, skills, routing rules, and schedules;
* skills\-based routing;
* agent/user provisioning and access models;
* data actions and workflow integrations;
* contact\-centre configuration changes;
* outbound contact\-centre capabilities where required;
* reporting and operational controls.
* Work with Bank teams to translate customer\-journey, business\-process, and operational requirements into scalable contact\-centre solutions.


**Integration and Automation**
* Develop integrations between Genesys Cloud and Bank platforms using:
* Genesys Cloud REST APIs;
* Genesys SDKs; o webhooks;
* JSON;
* APIs and middleware services.
* Develop automation scripts and utilities to reduce manual administrative activity and configuration risk.
* Implement automated configuration validation, environment comparison, health checks, and reporting.
* Integrate Genesys Cloud with ServiceNow and other approved Bank systems for incident, request, alerting, and fulfilment processes.
* Support integration with recording, quality\-management, reporting, and core banking\-related services as required.


**About You**
**DevOps and Release Engineering**
* Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for Genesys Cloud configurations, scripts, integration code, and deployment artefacts.
* Implement version\-controlled configuration management and deployment practices.
* Support configuration\-as\-code approaches and use Terraform where appropriate and approved.
* Automate testing, deployment validation, release evidence, and rollback procedures.
* Support environment promotion from development through test/UAT to production, complying with Bank change\-management and CAB processes.
* Provide L3/L4 technical troubleshooting for complex platform, routing, integration, and call\-flow issues. Operational Improvement
* Analyse Genesys Cloud incident, request, contact\-flow, queue, and routing\-performance trends to identify root causes and automation opportunities.
* Develop dashboards and reports for operational, business, and service\-performance stakeholders.
* Participate in problem management, root\-cause analysis, post\-incident reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Produce and maintain solution documentation, configuration records, support runbooks, and knowledge articles.


**Mandatory Technical Skills**
* Strong, hands\-on Genesys Cloud CX administration and development experience.
* Demonstrable experience in Genesys Cloud Architect, including IVR/call\-flow design and deployment.
* Strong experience with queue configuration, skills\-based routing, routing policies, schedules, and user/agent administration.
* Experience using Genesys Cloud REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and JSON.
* Proficiency in one or more of: JavaScript, Python, SQL, and API testing tools such as Postman.
* Experience designing and supporting system integrations in an enterprise environment.
* Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and controlled production releases.
* Experience working with incident, problem, change, and release\-management processes.
* Experience with contact\-centre analytics, reporting, and operational troubleshooting.


**Preferred Skills**
* Genesys Cloud certifications.
* Terraform and Infrastructure/Configuration\-as\-Code experience.
* Experience with Genesys Cloud outbound capabilities.
* Experience with bots, conversational AI, workforce engagement management, quality management, or call recording integrations.
* ServiceNow API/integration experience.


**Expected Deliverables**
* Automated and version\-controlled Genesys Cloud configuration deployments.
* IVR, routing, integration, and workflow solutions aligned to approved business requirements.
* CI/CD pipelines, test automation, release controls, and rollback plans.
* Automated health checks, configuration\-validation tools, and operational dashboards.
* Technical solution documentation, test evidence, operational runbooks, and support handover materials.
* Quantifiable automation benefits, including reduced manual configuration effort and improved release quality.


 You bring rigor, passion for challenges, and determination. You seek the opportunity to expand your expertise, achieve your goals, and thrive.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Global Opportunities: Work in multi\-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re\-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well\-being programs and benefits, diversity \& inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.


**Only Your Skills Matter**
 Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled\-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

title: Communication Development
description:
We, at Bharti Axa Life Insurance are seeking ambitious talent ready to make an immediate impact within our fast\-paced and innovative workplace. We are hiring for our Information Technology Department.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 Our mission is to create effortless customer\-centric digital experiences that enable customers to buy and manage their insurance policies digitally, by ensuring cost\-effective, scalable, and secured platform for all our products. Responsible for managing the “end\-to\-end” Digital product engineering portfolio, the Digital Product Engineer will build best\-in\-class digital platforms to execute the Business/Customer objectives.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 



* Provide solution oriented Engineering oversight for building \& maintaining direct to consumer digital platform for Bharti AXA Insurance
* Work with the Digital product managers and implementation partners to lead the platform design and implementation of the product backlog
* Weekly Measurement of Technical KPIs for D2C Digital Assets including website performance and user experience with actionable for improvement
* Enable robust integration solutions between Distribution partners and Bharti AXA via Technology provided backend APIs
* Collaborate with Digital Product managers for delivering and tracking the Business \& Technology KPIs \& metrics as part of the business plan
* Collaborate with back end IT teams for right set of APIs and other integration dependencies
* Identify the best practices \& guidelines for engineering (including DevSecOps and Test Automation) and create adoption plan
* Manage relationships with IT teams, partners/vendors
* Disciplined experimentation with new models \& platforms for higher business benefits



  





**We imagine you to be :** 



* Well versed with Application component architecture, design \& integration patterns
* Experienced with use of technologies like APIs \& Microservices, Content Management Systems, Modern Front end technologies like React/AngularJS, Rule engine, Building conversational interfaces using NLP/NLU, tools for monitoring website/app/SEO performance \& customer analytics and marketing automation
* Experience on AWS/Azure will be an added advantage
* Problem solving skills \& Conflict management/Negotiation
* Ability to build working relationships and strategic partnerships
* Ability to drive results, multi\-task and manage crisis situations
* Strong change management capabilities
* Superlative process orientation \& innovation capabilities
* Someone with very strong interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
* Strong work ethic, hardworking, willing to put in extra hours to meet deadlines
* Able to operate effectively in highly ambiguous settings and timeline pressure situations



  





  





**Qualification and Skills** 



* Bachelor of Engineering (Computer)/B.Tech\- I.T/Computer Science/MCA/Any Stream
* 7\-10 Years of experience in Digital and IT sector
* At least 2\-3 yrs. of technical implementation \& delivery of Customer facing Digital assets in an organization
* Delivered at least One medium to large scale Digital Transformation programme in last two years
* Managed an in\-house/partner team of at least 5\-10 engineers
* Worked in an agile/iterative environment with continuous delivery
* Managed stakeholders at mid\-senior management level
* Experienced in using Project Management tools like JIRA
* Adept at using Google Analytics, CRM systems, MS Office, design tools etc
* Extensive knowledge of architecture frameworks and tools. Research and analysis experience designing new architecture frameworks or enhancing existing architectures.
* Troubleshooting skills, the ability to determine issue impact, the ability to resolve complex issues, and the ability to consistently exercise sound judgment and initiative in stressful situations.

title: Technical Lead & Sr Developers Web And Blockchain Applications
description:
**About Bitfia** 




  





 Bitfia is building the next generation of global payment infrastructure using
 **blockchain, stablecoins, AI and modern payment technologies.** 




  





 Our flagship platform,
 **iPint** 
 , is designed to enable faster, smarter and more efficient global payments for businesses. We are also building advanced
 **stablecoin payment rails, payment orchestration and cross\-border payment infrastructure** 
 .
 



  





 We are looking for
 **Engineers who are exceptional hands\-on builders** 
 —those who can take a business or product requirement, think through the architecture, and rapidly turn it into production\-ready software.
 



  





 These senior experienced developers can design, develop, and scale high\-performance web applications and blockchain\-based payment solutions. The ideal candidates will lead technical architecture decisions, and ensure secure, scalable, and reliable systems.
 



  





 These developers will work closely with product, security, and business teams to deliver mission\-critical applications handling financial transactions and blockchain integrations.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As a
 **Senior Software Engineer** 
 , you will primarily own
 **backend engineering** 
 , APIs, payment infrastructure and core platform services, while also contributing to frontend development.
 



  




* Design and build
 **scalable backend services, APIs and payment infrastructure** 
 with a focus on performance, security and reliability.
* **Develop end\-to\-end payment flows** 
 including transaction processing, settlement, reconciliation and integrations with third\-party providers.
* Build integrations with blockchain networks, wallets, exchanges and third\-party providers.
* **Contribute across the full stack** 
 , including develop modern web applications and frontend components when required using React, Angular, Vue or similar technologies.
* **Use AI\-native development tools** 
 such as Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot and ChatGPT to accelerate coding, debugging, testing and delivery.
* **Own features end\-to\-end** 
 —from requirements and architecture through development, testing, deployment and production support.
* Solve complex technical problems with a high degree of independence.
* Help establish engineering practices that allow Bitfia to build and ship faster.
* **Work closely with founders and the engineering team** 
 on architecture, code quality, security and solving complex problems to continuously increase development velocity.



  





**Technical Skills** 




 ● Use AI tools/agents to automate, develop, build and productionize the code, you are free to use AI, but code ownership, which includes code correctness and production stability lies with you.
 



 ● Good understanding of how llm works for retraining and RAG, tool chains similar to langchain etc.
 



 ● Lead the end\-to\-end architecture of web and blockchain\-based systems.
 



 ● Make informed decisions on technology stack, design patterns, and frameworks.
 



 ● Review code, enforce best practices, and maintain high engineering standards.
 



  





**Web Application Development** 




 ● Design and build scalable, secure, high\-availability web applications.
 



 ● Work with modern frontend and backend frameworks.
 



 ● Optimize applications for performance, reliability, and maintainability.
 



 ● Implement RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL services.
 



**Blockchain \& Payment Systems** 




 ● Design and integrate blockchain\-based payment rails.
 



 ● Work with smart contracts, wallets, and transaction processing systems.
 



 ● Handle on\-chain and off\-chain interactions.
 



 ● Ensure security of transactions, private keys, and sensitive data.
 



 ● Integrate with third\-party payment providers and blockchain networks.
 



**Security \& Compliance** 




 ● Implement security best practices for financial and blockchain systems.
 



 ● Conduct threat modeling and code\-level security reviews.
 



 ● Ensure compliance with relevant standards (e.g., PCI\-DSS, data protection laws).
 



 ● Manage encryption, authentication, and authorization mechanisms.
 



**Collaboration \& Delivery** 




 ● Collaborate with product managers and founders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
 



 ● Ensure timely delivery of features with high quality.
 



 ● Participate in sprint planning, estimations, and technical discussions.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  





**Core Experience** 




 ● 3\+ years of professional software development experience.
 



 ● Strong experience in web application development, and capability to learn new domains and lead entire products.
 



 ● Hands\-on experience with blockchain technologies and payment systems.
 



  





**Technical Skills** 




 ● AI: Building agents using a mixture of experts, understanding of re\-training AIs for specific domains, RAG and GraphRags, training your own SLM’s.
 



 ● Backend: Python, golang, nodejs or similar
 



 ● Frontend: React, Angular, or Vue.js
 



 ● Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
 



 ● APIs: REST, GraphQL
 



 ● Cloud: AWS, GCP, or Azure
 



 ● DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines
 



  





**Blockchain \& Payments** 




 ● Experience with Ethereum / EVM\-compatible chains, or similar.
 



 ● Smart contracts (Solidity or equivalent).
 



 ● Wallet integrations and transaction lifecycle.
 



 ● Understanding of gas fees, confirmations, and blockchain security.
 



 ● Payment flows, settlements, and reconciliation.
 



  





**Soft Skills** 




 ● Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
 



 ● Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 



 ● Ability to balance hands\-on coding with leadership.
 



 ● Ownership mindset and attention to detail.
 



  





**Why Join Bitfia?** 



* Work on
 **real\-world global payment infrastructure** 
 .
* Build products involving
 **AI, blockchain and stablecoins** 
 .
* Work directly with founders and a highly entrepreneurial team.
* High ownership and autonomy.
* Opportunity to work across backend, frontend, blockchain and payment infrastructure.
* Rapid learning and career growth.
* Competitive compensation.
* **ESOP opportunities.**
* Opportunity to help build technology that can operate across global markets.
* Learning and growth opportunities.



  





  





 Experience: 4–8 Years
 



 Employment: Full\-time; Delhi NCR

title: DRDO DIPR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Now for 24 Posts
description:
**Defence Institute of Psychological Research (DIPR)** 
 , a part of Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has invited ITI pass\-outs to apply for the apprenticeship in different trades.
 **DRDO DIPR Apprentice Recruitment 2026** 
 is for 24 Apprentice posts in seven skills such as COPA, Photographer, Steward, IT/IT ESM etc. Candidates who have relevant ITI qualification can apply via Apprenticeship Portal and also can send the prescribed application form by e\-mail.
 **DRDO DIPR Apprentice Vacancy 2026** 
 is ideal for candidates who are interested in an Apprenticeship Program with DRDO DIPR and practical training at a Defence Research Organization.
 **All defence job in India** 
 through apprenticeship training is notified here. Applicants must be registered on the Apprenticeship Portal before applying. The selection will be done based on qualification in the examination or trade and may involve an interaction or interview.
   

  

 Overview of the Recruiting Institute

 is part of Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), Ministry of Defence. The institute is located in Timarpur, Delhi and is operating under the defence research framework and is working with ITI pass out students for the apprenticeship training programme. All those candidates who are keen to apply for Government Defence Jobs in India can take this chance for Trade\-specific training and practical experience through Apprenticeship.  Age Norms for Applicants

 Fee Requirements for Applicants
   

  

* Application Fee: Application fee not mentioned in notification.

 Selection Methodology
   

  

* Screening of Application: The applications will be screened by duly constituted screening committee of DIPR and the prescribed eligibility criteria will be cross\-checked with the available vacancies of Government Jobs in Delhi.
* Merit Selection: Selection of the candidates will be based on the marks obtained in the respective qualifying examination or ITI trade.
* Shortlisting: The board will shortlist the eligible applicants on the basis of the selection criteria, trade and number of vacancy.
* Interaction or Interview: DIPR may interact or interview depending on the number of candidates who apply for the advertised apprenticeship positions.
* Category\-Wise Merit: The merit list will be prepared under the applicable category\-wise reservation criterion for the UR, OBC, SC and ST candidates.
* Offer of Apprenticeship: DIPR shall email offer letter to selected candidates. Please check your registered email address regularly.
* Joining Verification: At the time of joining, the selected candidates are required to submit their original educational, ITI, category and other related documents and should also submit the necessary documents for the apprenticeship before joining the training program.


 Documents Required for DRDO DIPR Apprentice Recruitment 2026

* Valid ID documents: Aadhaar card and other valid ID documents
* Caste Certificate: If applicable, then SC/ST/OBC candidates should produce the Caste Certificate.

* Bank Details: This section contains bank account information linked with your Aadhaar.

* Time Management: Old papers are regularly solved to become fast and accurate in solving future competitive papers:
* Self Assessment: Assists the identification of areas of weakness in trade specific theoretical knowledge and applications.
* Confidence Building: Lessens the anxiety that is experienced when sitting for real interviews or interaction sessions with the selection board
* Technical Revision: Reinforce practical skills learnt from ITI training and fill up the gaps.
* Competitive Edge: Provides better preparation compared to other candidates applying for DRDO DIPR Recruitment 2026


 Training Terms and Conditions
   

  

* Procurement of Contracts: Online via NAPS\-Apprenticeship Portal as per Apprentices Act, 1961
* Nature of Engagement: Trainee; not a labourer; does not pay wages as per labour law; status does not exist.
* Extension Policy: 12\-months period is a fixed period and cannot be extended under any circumstances.
* Assessment: Required at end of training to receive National Apprenticeship Certificate
* Employment Clause: No regular employment following training completion,
* Cancellation Rights: DIPR reserves the rights to adjust or cancel the recruitment process.


 Submission Instructions for DRDO DIPR Apprentice Recruitment 2026
   

  

* Go to official website https://drdo.gov.in/drdo/en/ for DRDO DIPR Apprentice Recruitment 2026\.
* Go to “Vacancies” section and click on the advertisement named as “DIPR, Delhi invites eligible candidates for the engagement of ITI pass\-out Aprentices”.
* Please read eligibility details carefully for the particular trade before applying.
* To complete the mandatory form for NAPS portal, click on the link “apprenticeshipindia.gov.in“
* Fill in the form with details regarding the individual, their educational qualifications and the mobile phone number.
* Note down generated NATS or NAPS enrollment number for future reference
* Enter username and password and type E08260700022 in the search bar.
* Choose appropriate trade from 7 options available corresponding to your ITI qualification
* Complete the on\-line application form with the correct marks and experiences.
* Scan and upload required documents and photograph signature in the prescribed format.
* Download Application Form from DRDO Website and then send it by email.
* Provide scanned filled form with documents before deadline to admindipr.dipr@gov.in


 FAQs
   

  

 DRDO DIPR Apprentice Vacancy 2026 has 24 vacancies in seven trade. There are opportunities for COPA, Photographer, Steward, IT/IT ESM, Multimedia \& Web Page Designer, DTP Operator and Secretariat Assistant.
   

  

 The minimum educational qualification of the candidates is ITI in the related trade with the respective apprenticeship eligibility criteria. You must register on the Apprenticeship Portal before you can be considered.

 Selection in the DRDO DIPR Recruitment 2026 will be done mainly based on the marks secured in the relevant examination/ trade. Depending on the number of applicants, DIPR can also perform an interaction or interview.

title: Mobile Application Developer Intern (Flutter)
description:
***🚀 About Rishh Labs:***




  





 Rishh Labs is building AI\-first products, including SwitchWithAI, an AI\-powered job search platform, and Vitta, an AI expense manager. We're looking for a QA Automation Intern who is passionate about improving product quality through automation and testing.

* Collaborate with the product and development teams to implement new features.

title: Mobile Engineer III, iOS
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Introduction to the Team**
 The Expedia Group Payments team owns the Common Payment Module (CPM), the shared native library that powers checkout and payment capture across every Expedia Group brand's iOS and Android apps. We build the secure, high\-performance foundation that lets travellers save, select, and pay with their preferred payment method, seamlessly and reliably, at the single most business\-critical moment in the traveler journey.
   

  

 We are looking for a native iOS engineer who is excited to contribute to the growth and evolution of the CPM platform by delivering impactful features and infrastructure that delight customers and partners while meeting the rigorous security and compliance bar payments demands. You will work in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment where ownership, technical excellence, and innovation are highly valued.
   

  

 Team members on Payments are accountable for delivery and outcomes in a high\-impact environment. We embody the "One Team" philosophy and apply Agile, Lean, Continuous Delivery, and data\-driven principles across engineering and operations.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Design, develop, and maintain iOS applications using Swift and related Apple frameworks, ensuring performant, reliable, and maintainable mobile experiences.
* Contribute to system design, including API contracts, low\-level design, and data modelling for mobile features that integrate with backend services and shared platforms.
* Implement high\-quality, testable code by applying engineering best practices in code structure, unit testing, integration testing, and code reviews within an agile development environment.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across multiple product areas or domains to deliver reusable mobile components and services that can be leveraged across Expedia Group brands.
* Diagnose, debug, and resolve complex issues in production and pre\-production environments, contributing to robust monitoring, logging, and operational excellence for iOS applications.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled or AI‑assisted solutions within mobile workflows, including familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience in software development.
* Professional experience (typically 5\+ years) building and shipping native iOS applications using Swift, Xcode, and core iOS frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience owning features or services end\-to\-end within a mobile application, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Solid understanding of mobile system design fundamentals, including API design, data modelling, asynchronous programming, and performance optimization on iOS.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a collaborative engineering environment, participating in code reviews, using source control, and following established engineering and operational practices.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience designing and evolving iOS application architectures (such as MVVM, VIPER, or similar patterns) and contributing to shared mobile platforms or libraries used across multiple teams or product areas.
* Background working with large\-scale consumer mobile applications, including performance tuning, offline capabilities, analytics integration, and experimentation to drive data\-informed improvements.
* Proven contribution to system and API design in partnership with backend and platform teams, including defining contracts, data schemas, and integration patterns for mobile clients.
* Experience safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions on mobile (for example, AI\-assisted search, recommendations, personalization, or content generation), with familiarity using AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows in product development.
* Exposure to or experience with mobile CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, monitoring, and alerting for iOS apps, with a focus on maintaining high reliability and operational excellence.


**Accommodation requests**
 Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation.
   

  

**About Expedia Group**
 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
   

  

**Important notice**
 Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com.  From 2,716,737 INR
   

  

****Location:****
 India; Delhi, Ahmedabad (Hybrid)
   

  

****Application closing date:****
 8th October 2026
   

  

**If we receive a high volume of applications, we may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.**
**About The Job**
 The Product Engineer designs and builds the digital products that farmers, field teams, programme partners, and BCI teams rely on to collect data and carry out field activities. The role combines product judgement, design sensibility, and hands\-on software engineering to turn field and programme requirements into simple, reliable products in production. The Product Engineer is key strengthening the quality and usability of Better Cotton's field\-facing digital tools and, in turn, the efficiency of field operations across our programme geographies.
   

  

****The Challenge****
 Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will be responsible for :
   

  

* Review and stress\-test requirements from subject\-matter experts and programme teams, identifying unclear assumptions and unnecessary complexity before build begins.
* Partner with the Product Designer to shape simple, effective user flows for mobile, offline, and multilingual field use.
* Translate agreed solutions into clear, prioritised, testable delivery increments, and build high\-quality features across frontend, backend, and data layers.
* Use AI coding agents throughout prototyping, development, testing, and debugging to accelerate delivery without compromising quality, security, or maintainability.
* Write automated tests and instrument products to track adoption, performance, and reliability in real\-world field conditions.
* Release features safely, support their rollout, and iterate based on field feedback and product usage data.
* Work collaboratively with the line manager to set clear, outcome\-based objectives that align with function\-wide and organisational goals.
* Take ownership of agreed objectives, ensuring alignment with team priorities and performance expectations.


**Experience**
 the following skills, knowledge, and experience:
   

  

**Essential**
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience, with a strong track record of personally building, shipping, and improving production digital products that users value and rely on; evidence of judgement, scope, and delivery matters more than tenure.
* Experience taking products from prototype through production, rollout, and continuous improvement.
* Strong product and interaction\-design judgement, gained working closely with designers and subject\-matter experts.
* Experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production applications.
* Experience with agriculture, field operations, offline products, multilingual interfaces, geospatial workflows, or products for users with varying digital literacy is valuable.
* Experience building modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and related frontend technologies.
* Experience developing backend services, APIs, and databases using Python (or a comparable language), SQL, and cloud\-based infrastructure.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is essential.


**Desirable**
* Proficiency in Hindi, Urdu, Swahili, or other relevant languages would be advantageous.


**What We Offer**
* Hybrid working opportunity, with the office days based in Delhi.
* The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year
* Flexible working, with core hours from 10 am to 4 pm local time
* Continuous learning and development
* Pension scheme
* A generous annual leave package, including paid holiday, public holidays, additional paid days off during the festive season, study and exam days, and extra discretionary leave for life events such as family weddings or moving home
* Enhanced parental benefits
* The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.


****Working arrangements****
 The position is full\-time (40 hours per week) and will be based in Delhi. Better Cotton Initiative offers flexible working, with core hours being 10 am – 4 pm. The position may require limited international travel.
   

  

****Apply now****
 Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1\-page maximum) by or before
 ****08\.10\.2026****
 via the application link.
   

  

 In your cover letter, please include an explanation of why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton Initiative. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.
   

  

 Better Cotton Initiative does not use artificial intelligence or in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human\-led assessment experience.
   

  

****Our hiring process****
**Initial Screening**
 Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicant. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.
   

  

**Interviews**
 If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton Initiative may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.
   

  

**Assessment And Testing**
 Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position. Internal candidates may have the option to demonstrate their existing skills through current job performance or past project outcomes.
   

  

**Reference Checks**
 Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications, and for some roles, your education and criminal history. Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton Initiative to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.
   

  

**Offer Stage**
 After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details. For internal candidates, the offer process may include a discussion about how your transition to the new role will be managed and any support needed for a smooth handover.
   

  

**About Better Cotton Initiative**
 Better Cotton Initiative is a global not\-for\-profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand. In just 15 years we have aligned more than a fifth of the world’s cotton with our standard and helped farmers and farming communities thrive. Join us in building a better, more sustainable future for cotton worldwide.
   

  

**About Our Values**
 The post holder will be expected to operate in line with our workplace values which are:
   

  

* Trustworthy (including honest, transparent, credible)
* As having Integrity (including responsible, authentic)
* Positive (including problem\-solving, pragmatic)
* Engaging (including adaptable, inclusive, holistic)
* Daring (including courageous, innovative, game\-changing)


****Being you @ Better Cotton****
****Initiative****
 Better Cotton Initiative is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources.
   

  

 We have a zero\-tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including, dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

title: Principal Mobile Engineer
description:
**About Payoneer**
 Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
   

  

 By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi\-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
   

  

**Principal Mobile Engineer**
 AI\-Native Cloud Platform
   

  

**Team:** 
 Mobile Platform Team
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Sr. Director of R\&D, Cloud Platform
   

  

**Location:** 
 \[Gurgaon / Hybrid]
   

  

**About The Role**
 Payoneer is investing in the next generation of its mobile application: lightweight, high\-performance, and designed as a platform that lets product teams contribute features independently while the app remains coherent, fast, and stable as a whole. The host application will provide the common foundations — observability, logging, navigation, identity, networking, feature flags, release tooling, automation — and product teams will plug into it through a clear contribution model.
   

  

 We are hiring two Principal Mobile Engineers to define and build this foundation alongside the existing mobile team. Together you will own the tech stack decision — native iOS and Android, Flutter, React Native or a hybrid — and you will shape the platform every product team at Payoneer ships mobile features on top of. The two\-Principal structure gives us the capacity to build the platform properly, and the optionality to specialize one Principal per native platform if we go that route.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
 You will own the tech stack decision and the rationale behind it. You will run the evaluation — native (Swift / Kotlin) vs Flutter vs React Native vs hybrid — against real constraints: performance, binary size, hiring market, team contribution model, build and release velocity, long\-term maintenance cost. You will make the call jointly with your peer Principal and you will be expected to defend it under scrutiny from engineering, product, and executive leadership.
   

  

 You will build the host application foundation. The architecture, the module boundaries, the navigation and lifecycle model, the dependency injection approach, the state management patterns, the threading and concurrency model, the network stack, the persistence layer, the observability and logging backbone, the release and rollout machinery, the testing strategy at every level of the pyramid. Every product team’s first impression of mobile at Payoneer will be the abstractions you ship.
   

  

 You will define the contribution model that product teams use to deliver features into the host app. Module boundaries, public API surface, lifecycle hooks, dependency policy, build and integration patterns, version compatibility, and the developer experience that makes contributing a feature fast and contributing a bad one hard. You will own the standards every contributing team writes against.
   

  

 You will own performance, binary size, startup time, frame rate, memory, and battery as first\-class engineering disciplines with measured budgets and gates. You will own crash\-free rate and stability as platform commitments. You will own the CI/CD, signing, release, and rollout pipeline for the app, and the observability that makes a production issue debuggable in minutes rather than days.
   

  

 You will partner with the Application Foundations Crew and the Cloud Platform Base, DevEx, and Network and Security teams to make sure mobile integrates cleanly with the platform — APIs, events, identity, secrets, automation and the shift\-left controls that apply on the mobile side as much as the server side. You will partner with product engineering across the company to bring contributing teams into the platform and keep them productive in it.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
 You have ten or more years of mobile engineering experience and you have built mobile applications from the ground up — not joined them, not iterated on them, but defined the foundation and shipped it to production at scale. You have an honest, scarred view of what mobile platform decisions cost three years after you make them.
   

  

 You are deeply expert in at least one of iOS or Android, and seriously fluent in the other. On iOS that means Swift, the Swift concurrency model, UIKit and SwiftUI, the Apple toolchain and release process, and the parts of the ecosystem most engineers learn the hard way. On Android that means Kotlin, coroutines and Flow, the Android lifecycle, Jetpack and Compose, Gradle in earnest, RxJava where it still lives, and the same hard\-won understanding of the ecosystem.
   

  

 You understand the cross\-platform landscape with the same honesty. You have an opinion on Flutter, KMP, and React Native that goes beyond preference — performance characteristics, ceiling, where each shines, where each fails — and you can defend the recommendation you would make for a fintech app at Payoneer’s scale.
   

  

 You have built and operated a modular mobile platform before, or something close enough that you understand the trade\-offs: how to define module boundaries that survive ten product teams contributing in parallel, how to keep the host app coherent when contributors disagree, how to version a contribution model without breaking everyone, and how to keep the binary lean as the surface grows.
   

  

 You think in budgets and measurements. You have driven startup time, frame rate, binary size, and crash\-free rate as numbers on a dashboard. You understand mobile observability at a level beyond crash reporting, and you have shipped the instrumentation needed to debug productio.
   

  

 You communicate clearly with engineers, product partners, and executives. You can write a one\-page architecture proposal, run an RFC that actually converges, demo what you built so other engineers want to use it, and explain a stack decision to a CPO in language they care about. You handle disagreement well — including with your peer Principal — and you know how to land a joint decision.
   

  

**Nice to have**
 Experience integrating AI capabilities into mobile applications — on\-device models, conversational and agent UI patterns, latency\-sensitive AI features, and the privacy and offline considerations that come with them — is a strong plus, given Payoneer’s AI\-native platform direction.
   

  

**Why this role matters**
 The mobile app is the surface Payoneer customers touch after Web. The foundation you build will compound for years. You will have unusual scope to define what good looks like for Payoneer, and credibly for the industry, at the point where regulated payments, mobile engineering at scale, and AI\-native development converge.
   

  

**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
 If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
   

  

*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case\-by\-case basis.*

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Customer-Facing | Prompt Engineering | AI Automation)
description:
**About This Job**
**MyOperator**
**Location:** 
 Greater Delhi Area, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Software Development,Telecommunications,IT Services and IT Consulting
   

  

**Job Description**
 About MyOperator
   

  

 MyOperator is a Business AI Operator and category leader that unifies WhatsApp, Calls, and AI\-powered chatbots \& voice bots into one intelligent business communication platform.Unlike fragmented communication tools, MyOperator combines automation, intelligence, and workflow integration to help businesses run WhatsApp campaigns, manage calls, deploy AI chatbots, and track performance — all from a single no\-code platform.Trusted by 12,000\+ brands including Amazon, Domino’s, Apollo, and Razor\-pay, MyOperator enables faster responses, higher resolution rates, and scalable customer engagement
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 We’re hiring a Front Deployed Engineer (FDE)—a customer\-facing, field\-deployed engineer who owns the end\-to\-end delivery of AI bots/agents.
   

  

 This role is “frontline”: you’ll work directly with customers (often onsite), translate business reality into bot workflows, do prompt engineering \+ knowledge grounding, ship deployments, and iterate until it works reliably in production.
   

  

 Think: solutions engineer \+ implementation engineer \+ prompt engineer, with a strong bias for execution.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Requirement Discovery \& Stakeholder Interaction


 Join customer calls alongside Sales and Revenue teams.Ask targeted questions to understand business objectives, user journeys, automation expectations, and edge cases.Identify data sources (CRM, APIs, Excel, SharePoint, etc.) required for the solution.Act as the AI subject\-matter expert during client discussions.
   

  

* Use Case \& Solution Documentation


 Convert discussions into clear, structured use case documents, including:Problem statement \& goals.Current vs. proposed conversational flows.Chatbot conversation logic, integrations, and dependencies.Assumptions, limitations, and success criteria.
   

  

* Customer Delivery Ownership


 Own deployment of AI bots for customer use\-cases (lead qualification, support, booking, etc.). Run workshops to capture processes, FAQs, edge cases, and success metrics. Drive the go\-live process: requirements through monitoring and improvement.
   

  

* Prompt Engineering \& Conversation Design


 Craft prompts, tool instructions, guardrails, fallbacks, and escalation policies for stable behavior. Build structured conversational flows: intents, entities, routing, handoff, and compliant responses. Create reusable prompt patterns and "prompt packs."
   

  

* Testing, Debugging \& Iteration


 Analyze logs to find failure modes (misclassification, hallucination, poor handling). Create test sets ("golden conversations"), run regressions, and measure improvements. Coordinate with Product/Engineering for platform needs.
   

  

* Integrations \& Technical Coordination


 Integrate bots with APIs/webhooks (CRM, ticketing, internal tools) to complete workflows. Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate fixes/root\-cause analysis.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Customer bots go live quickly and show high containment \+ high task completion with low escalation.You can diagnose failures from transcripts/logs and fix them with prompt/workflow/knowledge changes.Customers trust you as the “AI delivery owner”—clear communication, realistic timelines, crisp execution.
   

  

 Requirements (Must Have)
   

  

 2–5 years in customer\-facing delivery roles: implementation, solutions engineering, customer success engineering, or similar.Hands\-on comfort with LLMs and prompt engineering (structured outputs, guardrails, tool use, iteration).Strong communication: workshops, requirement capture, crisp documentation, stakeholder management.Technical fluency: APIs/webhooks concepts, JSON, debugging logs, basic integration troubleshooting.Willingness to be front deployed (customer calls/visits as needed).
   

  

 Good to Have (Nice to Have)
   

  

 Experience with chatbots/voicebots, IVR, WhatsApp automation, conversational AI platforms with at least a couple of projects.Understanding of metrics like containment, resolution rate, response latency, CSAT drivers.Prior SaaS onboarding/delivery experience in mid\-market or enterprises.
   

  

 Working Style \& Traits We Value
   

  

 High agency: you don’t wait for perfect specs—you create clarity and ship.Customer empathy \+ engineering discipline.Strong bias for iteration: deploy → learn → improve.Calm under ambiguity (real customer environments are chaotic by default).

title: Mobile App UI/UX Designer - Figma, Motion & Miro-interactions
description:
Mobile App UI/UX Designer — Figma, Motion \& Micro\-interactions
 



  





 📍 Delhi NCR \| On\-site \| Full\-Time \| Early Team
 



  





 About Tobbo
 



  





 Tobbo is an early\-stage consumer social app built around a deeply human behaviour — our curiosity to know what people really think.
 



  





 Our core product behaviours and flows are being defined. We’re looking for a mobile\-first UI/UX designer who can turn those ideas into a beautiful, intuitive and highly polished consumer mobile experience.
 



  





 This is not a web\-design or graphic\-design role. We’re specifically looking for someone who understands how great consumer mobile apps should look, feel, move and respond.
 



  





 What You’ll Own
 



  





 \* Own Tobbo’s end\-to\-end mobile UI/UX design in Figma.
 



 \* Turn product requirements and user behaviours into intuitive mobile flows and interfaces.
 



 \* Create wireframes, high\-fidelity screens and interactive prototypes.
 



 \* Own visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, layouts, components, states and design consistency.
 



 \* Design micro\-interactions, transitions, gestures and motion that make the product feel alive and responsive.
 



 \* Think through every important state — loading, empty, error, success, selected, disabled, notifications and edge cases.
 



 \* Build and maintain Tobbo’s mobile design system and reusable component library.
 



 \* Work closely with developers to ensure the final product accurately reflects the intended experience.
 



 \* Review implemented screens and independently identify UX/UI imperfections.
 



 \* Continuously improve the product based on user behaviour, feedback and experimentation.
 



 \* Extend the product’s design language to responsive web experiences when required.
 



  





 Who We’re Looking For
 



  





 You should have strong hands\-on experience designing mobile applications, not primarily websites.
 



  





 We’re looking for someone with:
 



  





 \* Strong command of Figma, including components, variants, auto layout and interactive prototyping.
 



 \* Excellent understanding of mobile UI/UX and interaction design.
 



 \* Strong visual taste — typography, spacing, hierarchy, composition and consistency.
 



 \* Experience designing animations, transitions and micro\-interactions.
 



 \* Understanding of iOS/Android interaction patterns, gestures and mobile usability.
 



 \* Ability to take a product idea or defined behaviour and independently turn it into a polished experience — without requiring pixel\-by\-pixel direction.
 



 \* Ability to work closely with engineers and design experiences that can actually be implemented.
 



 \* Strong product thinking: you should be able to explain why an interaction or design decision improves the user experience.
 



  





 Experience with consumer social, creator, dating, gaming, entertainment, community or other highly interactive mobile products is a strong advantage.
 



  





 This Role Is NOT For
 



  





 This role is not primarily for:
 



  





 \* Website/web\-app designers
 



 \* SaaS/dashboard\-focused designers
 



 \* Graphic designers or branding\-only designers
 



 \* Social\-media creatives
 



 \* Developers looking for a frontend engineering position
 



  





 We are specifically looking for someone at the intersection of:
 



  





 Mobile UI/UX × Consumer Product Design × Figma × Interaction Design × Motion
 



  





 Show Us Your Mobile Work
 



  





 Your portfolio will matter more than the number of years on your résumé.
 



  





 Please share 2–3 mobile apps or mobile product experiences that you personally designed.
 



  





 We especially want to see:
 



  





 Beautiful mobile UI · complete UX flows · interactive Figma prototypes · transitions · animations · gestures · micro\-interactions
 



  





 For each project, tell us clearly what you personally owned.
 



  





 If your portfolio is primarily websites, landing pages or dashboards, this role is unlikely to be the right fit.
 



  





 📩 jointobbo@gmail.com
 



 Or apply directly through LinkedIn with your résumé and portfolio.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon \- WeWork, Cybercity (in\-person, 6 days)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time · Founding team
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹15 LPA \+ meaningful equity (0\.5–2%)
 



  





**About Switch** 




 Businesses in India lose money every day someone doesn't show up. A restaurant short two waiters on a Friday night, a warehouse missing four loaders before a festive spike, a store with no one to run the counter \- the current fix is a WhatsApp group, an agency that takes a cut and disappears, or the owner working the floor themselves.
 



 Switch is building the layer that fixes this. Shops, restaurants, warehouses, offices, and event venues book Aadhaar\-verified staff \- helpers, guards, cooks, drivers, riders, housekeeping, event crew \- in three taps, often deployed the same day. No advance, replacement guaranteed, clean invoices. On the other side, we give workers real, repeat, dignified income instead of standing at a labour chowk hoping for a day's work.
 



 We're live in Gurgaon, running real shifts for real businesses. We're small, pre\-seed, and moving fast.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'd be our first engineer. Not the first engineer on a team \- the engineering team.
 



 Today a lot of Switch runs on human effort: matching, confirmations, replacements, and support all lean on the ops team and WhatsApp. That's the right way to start and the wrong way to scale. Your job is to turn what ops does by hand into software that does it in seconds, and to build the product surface \- worker app, business app, internal tools \- that lets us go from one city to many.
 



 You will write the code, choose the stack, ship it, and be on the hook when it breaks at 9pm on a Saturday during someone's dinner rush. In return you get real ownership of the technical direction and a front\-row seat to everything else: pricing, ops, hiring, fundraising.
 



  





**What you'll actually build (first 6 months)** 



* Matching engine. Turn a booking into the right worker — availability, location, skill, reliability history, price \- fast enough that "same day" becomes "same hour."
* Worker app. Shift discovery, one\-tap accept, check\-in/check\-out with geofencing, attendance proof, payouts and earnings history.
* Business app \+ web. Booking flow, live shift status, replacements, subscription management, GST\-clean invoicing.
* Ops console. The internal tool that lets one ops person run what currently takes three \- exception queues, no\-show detection and auto\-replacement, escalations.
* Payments and payouts. Collections, worker payouts, reconciliation, refunds \- via UPI and standard PGs.
* Trust infrastructure. Aadhaar/KYC verification flows, background\-check pipeline, ratings, fraud and proxy\-attendance detection.



  





**You're probably a fit if you** 



* Have 2\-6 years shipping production software, and can point at systems you built end\-to\-end \- schema through UI \- that real users depended on.
* Are genuinely full\-stack: comfortable in a backend language and framework of your choice, a modern frontend, a mobile framework (React Native / Flutter / native), SQL, and enough AWS/GCP to run it all without a DevOps hire.
* Have built for scrappy, real\-world conditions: flaky networks, ₹8,000 Android phones, users who won't read instructions, workflows that live in Hindi and WhatsApp.
* Ship fast and ruthlessly scope. You know which corners are safe to cut at pre\-seed and which ones will burn you.
* Will sit with an ops teammate for an afternoon, watch them do a job manually, and go build the thing that deletes it.
* Want to be in the room. This is an in\-person role \- the speed comes from the whiteboard, the desk next to you, and the field visits.



  





**Nice to have, not required** 



* Marketplace, gig\-economy, logistics, or on\-demand experience (Zomato/Swiggy/Urban Company/Rapido/Porter\-shaped problems).
* Payments, UPI, KYC, or fintech integration work.
* Blue\-collar or Bharat\-focused products; vernacular UX.
* You've been early at a startup before and know what year one really feels like.



 The honest part
 



 Pre\-seed means uncertainty. Some of what you build will be thrown away. You'll do things that aren't engineering \- sit in on sales calls, go to a client's warehouse at 7am, help onboard workers. There is no platform team, no on\-call rotation, no one to hand a bug to. Runway is finite and the equity is a bet, not a guarantee.
 



 If that reads as a warning, this isn't your role. If it reads as the interesting part, keep going.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Competitive cash for a pre\-seed startup, plus founding\-level equity.
* Full technical ownership \- stack, architecture, hiring the team under you.
* Direct work with the founders, no layers.
* Health insurance and a laptop of your choosing.
* A product where you can watch the impact the same week you ship it \- in shifts filled, and in what a worker took home.



  





**How to apply** 




 Email hr@switchlocally.com with the subject "Founding Engineer" and include:
 


1. Your GitHub, portfolio, or the most interesting thing you've shipped \- and what your specific contribution was.
2. A short answer: You have one week and no data science team. How would you decide which worker to send to a booking? A paragraph is plenty. We care about how you think, not the right answer.
3. Anything you've built that people outside your company actually used.



 We move fast: intro call, a paid take\-home or a day working with us on a real problem, founder conversation, offer. Typically under two weeks.

title: Product Quality Intern
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building more than just AI tools; we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post\-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world. From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
   

  

 We’re a fast\-growing, passionate team backed over 100K\+ active users globally.
   

  

 But we’re just getting started. Our mission is clear: solve the biggest pain points in photography, and keep evolving with photographers who use our tools daily.
   

  

 If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
   

  

 🚀
 **About the Role**
 A wedding photographer shoots 4,000 photos on a Saturday.
   

  

 Before Aftershoot, that meant three nights hunched over a screen, clicking through near\-identical frames, missing dinner, missing their kids, missing the life they take pictures of for everyone else.
   

  

 With Aftershoot, it takes an hour.
   

  

 That hour is the entire product. 100,000\+ photographers around the world trust us with it. Culling, editing, retouching \- our AI does the grunt work so they can go back to doing the thing they actually love.
   

  

 Which means when we ship a bug, we don't ship an inconvenience. We ship somebody's ruined Sunday. That's where you come in.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Every engineer here builds a piece of the product. The PM holds the plan for it. Design holds the intent.
   

  

 You're the only person on the team whose entire job is to know what the product
 **actually does** 
 .
   

  

 Not what the ticket said. Not what the spec promised. What happens when a photographer drags in 12,000 RAW files, loses Wi\-Fi halfway through, closes the laptop lid, and reopens it four hours later on battery.
   

  

 We're not hiring you to tick boxes on a test sheet. You'll write code, own an automation suite, and hold the call on whether something is fit to go in front of 100,000 photographers. We're hiring you to become the person we can't ship without.
   

  

**Here's the bar we're setting, out loud:**
 Six months in, when an engineer and a PM disagree about how a flow is supposed to behave, someone in that room should say "just ask \[your name]" and that settles it.
   

  

 You will know this product better than the people who built it. That's not a stretch goal. That's the job.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Basic programming in JavaScript or TypeScript
* Comfort with browser developer tools
* A grasp of testing fundamentals — test cases, severity, the defect lifecycle, what regression actually means
* Sharp analytical instincts and genuinely strong attention to detail
* Clear written and verbal communication (a bug report is writing)
* Real eagerness to learn automation, not just tolerance for it
* BE/B.Tech, BCA, MCA, or B.Sc in CS/IT — freshers and final\-year students very welcome


**Preferred Skills (Good To Have)**
* Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress
* Git / GitHub
* REST APIs and API testing
* Anything you've built and shipped yourself, however small


**You will work with**
* Captain: Neha
* Team Members: Vikas, Aditi and the rest of the Aftershoot team.

 • How did you solve them?
 



 • What did you learn?

 Can you break an unfamiliar problem into smaller pieces and work towards a solution?

 Do you explore technology beyond your college curriculum?

 • Full Stack / MERN

 • Cloud \& DevOps
 



 • Automation \& Integrations

 We want to identify people with strong fundamentals and learning ability and then align them with the technology track where they can perform best.

title: Principal / Senior Software Engineer - Mobile Monetization (Ad Server)
description:
**About The Role**
 PubMatic is seeking an experienced and technically strong Principal Software Engineer to lead the design and development of next\-generation Mobile App Monetization capabilities. This role is focused on building high\-performance, low\-latency, scalable, and privacy\-safe systems that help maximize publisher revenue from in\-app inventory while improving DSP and buyer spend efficiency.
   

  

 The role requires a deep understanding of mobile app advertising, SSP\-DSP RTB workflows, OpenRTB mobile signals, SDK/mediation integrations, traffic shaping, QPS optimization, mobile attribution, privacy constraints, and performance advertising. The engineer will work on systems that monetize mobile formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video ads.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a seasoned backend engineer with strong ad\-tech domain expertise and experience building real\-time auction, targeting, decisioning, and optimization systems. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketplace Quality, DSP Partnerships, Publisher teams, and SRE to build ML\-integrated and data\-driven monetization systems that improve yield, bid rate, win rate, fill rate, attribution readiness, latency, and reliability across PubMatic’s mobile app ecosystem.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Architect and implement scalable backend services powering mobile app monetization, extracting, transforming, and optimizing in\-app behavioral data using on\-device computation, data aggregation, and differential privacy techniques so that publishers can still deliver targeted ads and measure performance without accessing persistent, individual user identities.
* Build and optimize SSP\-DSP integration workflows for mobile app inventory, including app bundle validation, device and geo signal handling, privacy\-aware user signal processing, bid response handling, loss reason analysis, and DSP\-specific troubleshooting.
* Design mobile\-specific traffic shaping and QPS optimization systems that prioritize high\-value in\-app inventory based on bid probability, win probability, spend potential, app quality, device signals, geo value, ad format, consent availability, and DSP buying behavior.
* Improve runtime handling for Mobile App ad formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and in\-app video, including format eligibility, creative compatibility, response validation, tracking, completion, and reward\-callback correctness.
* Build capabilities that improve buyer/DSP compatibility for MApp inventory, ensuring buyers receive well\-represented, privacy\-compliant, format\-compatible, attribution\-ready, and supply\-quality\-aware mobile app requests.
* Develop systems and diagnostics to improve Mobile App supply quality, including app bundle validation, app store metadata checks, app\-ads.txt, sellers.json, SupplyChain object validation, app spoofing detection, invalid traffic indicators, device/geo inconsistency checks, and low\-quality partner supply detection.
* Support privacy\-aware and attribution\-ready Mobile App advertising, including ATT/IDFA handling, AAID availability, consent enforcement, COPPA/child\-directed treatment, SKAN readiness, MMP signal passing, click/impression tracking, and privacy\-safe fallback when user\-level identifiers are unavailable.
* Partner with MApp SDK and OpenBid/S2S integration teams to define signal\-quality standards, request\-field expectations, placement/ad\-unit semantics, tracking requirements, and partner feedback loops for Mobile App supply.
* Build publisher\-facing and buyer\-facing diagnostics for MApp inventory, including missing\-field reports, app quality signals, buyer no\-bid diagnostics, fill and eCPM diagnostics, tracking mismatch analysis, attribution readiness, and supply\-path quality insights.
* Work with DSP Partnerships and Marketplace Quality teams to improve buyer confidence in PubMatic’s MApp supply by addressing format compatibility, attribution readiness, privacy eligibility, fraud risk, supply transparency, and app inventory quality.
* Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Publisher teams, DSP Partnerships, Marketplace Quality, MApp SDK, OpenBid/S2S integrations, and SRE to define and execute the roadmap for differentiated Mobile App advertising capabilities.
* Champion operational excellence for Mobile App advertising systems through strong observability, reason codes, structured logs, dashboards, alerts, safe rollouts, latency protection, production debugging, and cross\-team incident response.


**We'd Love for You to Have**
* Five plus years of backend engineering experience, with a proven track record of building high\-scale, low\-latency systems, preferably in mobile app advertising, SSP, DSP, ad exchange, mediation, mobile SDK, app\-install, or programmatic AdTech domains.
* Strong knowledge of mobile app inventory signals, including app bundle, app store URL, SDK version, placement type, rewarded indicator, device ID, IDFA, AAID, IDFV, OS version, carrier, connection type, geo, consent status, and ad format metadata.

* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset, strong ownership, and ability to work cross\-functionally with Product, Data Science, DSP Partnerships, Publisher teams, Marketplace Quality, and SRE.


**Bonus Qualifications**

* Experience with cross\-format mobile monetization strategies, including combining rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video monetization within the same app session.
* Familiarity with real\-time analytics pipelines used to measure mobile monetization KPIs such as bid rate, win rate, fill rate, eCPM, revenue, QPS efficiency, timeout rate, attribution feedback, buyer spend, and yield efficiency.
* Publications, patents, internal platform leadership, or speaking engagements in mobile monetization, AdTech infrastructure, RTB optimization, privacy\-safe advertising, or ML for AdTech.


**Why Join Us?**
